首段.英文: Seibukyūjō-mae Station (西武球場前駅, Seibu-Kyūjō-mae-eki) is a junction passenger railway station located in the city of Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan, operated by the private railway operator Seibu Railway. It is located in front of the Seibu Dome, the home field of the Saitama Seibu Lions baseball team owned by Seibu Railway.
